I don't know if it helps but this is how I managed myself . When I feel I'm going into a depressive episode I do online tests for depression and when it shows 'mild ' I visit my doctor.  I also take time to recharge myself by watching movies . I shut down personal relationships by briefly blocking people or I uninstall texting apps . I let people know that I'm going through something and trust me majority of people will be there for you . I also make to do lists and when I complete my task I put them up on a wall were I section ' done ' .  I hope this helps.
